fact: In its contribution to the 17 November 2025 UN CSTD panel, Burkina Faso said universities study over fifty AI solutions, including plant disease detection and crop yield forecasting, and that a national AI action plan with pilot projects in priority sectors is being drawn up.
title: Contribution by Burkina Faso to the CSTD 2025-2026 priority theme on Science, Technology and Innovation in the age of AI
